## Example 4.3 · Compound interest over 11 years {#fm5-example-4-3-a .fm-slide }

Jack invests \$16 000 at 12% p.a., with interest paid monthly for 11 years.

a) Find the compound interest earned over 11 years to the nearest dollar.

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 12 · Example 4.3 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
Monthly rate = 1%, n=132. $A=16000(1.01)^{132}\approx59503.33699$. $I=A-16000\approx43503.33699$. To the nearest dollar, compound interest is \$43 503. Keep the unrounded value for the comparison.
:::
